name: @agents-js/mcp-bus-bridge
description: MCP bridge consumer for the gateway bus. Subscribes to /events SSE and emits each event as an MCP server-initiated notification, so MCP-speaking clients (Claude Code, Claude Desktop) receive gateway-bus events in-context.
author: Jens Bodal

scripts.build: bunx tsdown src/index.ts src/bin.ts --format esm --dts --out-dir dist --clean
